pr_title: Publish verified Oyatie API contract surface
summary: F7 security review for PR #1: reviewed GitHub PR status plus merged workflow evidence; 3 actionable findings, highest severity BLOCKER.

findings.issue: The PR was merged even though the static ADR-0039 supply-chain gate concluded FAILURE and the release artifact Trivy/Cosign/SBOM lane was SKIPPED. A baseline described as verified cannot be trusted when its release/security evidence lane did not pass before merge.
findings.remediation: Treat PR #1 as an unverified bootstrap until the current target SHA reruns the supply-chain and release-attestation checks successfully; make the baseline gate fail closed on any failed or skipped security sub-lane.

findings.issue: The release-artifact-attestation job depended on the static wiring job. On a release tag, a static gate failure would skip the release attestation lane instead of surfacing both failures in one run.
findings.remediation: Remove the release-attestation dependency on the static wiring job; run both sub-lanes independently and add a rollup that fails if either relevant result is not success.

findings.issue: Supply-chain-sensitive workflows used floating action tags such as actions/checkout@v4 instead of commit-pinned actions, leaving the verified contract baseline dependent on mutable third-party action references.
findings.remediation: Pin every GitHub Action in release/security workflows to a reviewed commit SHA and add a CI lane that rejects non-SHA action references.
